entities.summary: Sergei Vladimirovich Andronov is a Russian former professional ice hockey player. He most recently played for SKA Saint Petersburg of the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL). He previously played in the KHL with Lada Togliatti, CSKA Moscow and Lokomotiv Yaroslavl.
